products.name: Content Marketing Plan
products.description:
Content & Digital Presence Audit: Evaluate existing website content, blogs, email marketing, social media, SEO performance, and current content assets to identify strengths, gaps, and opportunities.

Audience, Messaging & Competitive Analysis: Review target audiences, buyer journeys, key messaging, and competitor content strategies to uncover opportunities for differentiation and engagement.

Content Strategy & Campaign Planning: Develop a customized content marketing strategy aligned to business goals, including recommended content themes, channels, campaign ideas, and lead generation opportunities.

90-Day Content Marketing Roadmap: Deliver a prioritized action plan outlining recommended content initiatives, publishing cadence, campaign recommendations, SEO opportunities, and key performance metrics for measuring success.

Deliverables Included:
- Competitive & Messaging Analysis
- Recommended Content Pillars/Themes
- 90-Day Editorial & Campaign Roadmap
- Strategy Review Meeting
